reason: The chapter says the lane-born stars are approaching the returning galaxy's stellar outskirts, matching the goal.

choice.combine: Stars born in the dark lane
choice.with: Stellar outskirts of the returning galaxy

expectation: The stars will pass through the other galaxy's outskirts, likely without colliding with individual stars.

effect: The crossing confirmed that the lane-born stars pass between other stars while their paths bend, unlike the gas from which they formed.
reaction: The contrast between colliding gas and surviving stars was satisfying and clarified the chapter's point.

mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing the lane-born stars through the crossing made the difference between gas and stellar encounters concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was only one gameplay decision, so no passage stood out as repetitive or particularly unhelpful.

surprise.text: The same material behaved differently after becoming stars: its gas collided, but the stars passed between one another.

arbitrary.text: The action followed directly from the chapter's setup and goal; it did not feel arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue for the connected scientific story, though this chapter offered too little choice to judge the gameplay's lasting appeal.
